frontend.installTitleApple: Your family tree on iPhone & iPad
frontend.installIntro: Keep your family archive one tap away with a shortcut on your home screen.
frontend.installAndroidStep1: Open this page in Chrome on your Android phone or tablet.
frontend.installAndroidStep2: Open the browser menu (⋮) beside the address bar.
frontend.installAndroidStep3: Choose “Install and create shortcut” → “Install”, or “Add to Home screen”, then follow your browser’s instructions.
frontend.installAppleStep1: Open this page in Safari on your iPhone or iPad.
frontend.installAppleStep2: Tap the Share button in Safari.
frontend.installAppleStep3: Choose “Add to Home Screen”. If it is missing, look under “Edit Actions”.
frontend.installAppleStep4: If offered, turn on “Open as Web App”, then tap “Add”.
frontend.installOnline: An internet connection is needed to open the family archive.
frontend.installAccepted: Installation requested. Follow your browser to finish.
